findings.title: Single SendGrid failure aborts all cancellations and skips DB deletes
findings.body: In scheduleEmailReminders.ts the loop awaits client.request for each reminderToCancel sequentially and only collects prisma.workflowReminder.delete promises to run in Promise.all after the loop. If any one cancel request throws (e.g. null referenceId, expired batch_id, network error), control jumps to the outer catch, Promise.all is never reached, and even reminders already cancelled at SendGrid are never deleted from the DB. They will be retried every 15 min and other pending cancellations in the same batch are starved, so cancelled/rescheduled emails can still be sent.

findings.title: immediateDelete cancels SendGrid but never removes DB row
findings.body: deleteScheduledEmailReminder with immediateDelete=true sends POST /v3/user/scheduled_sends cancel and then returns without deleting or updating the WorkflowReminder row. Callers in handleNewBooking.ts reschedule path and workflows.tsx delete-workflow/delete-step paths pass true expecting the reminder to disappear. The row stays with scheduled=true and referenceId set, leaking indefinitely and never matching the cron cancelled=true cleanup, so DB accumulates orphans pointing at old bookings.

findings.title: Unscheduled-reminder query ignores cancelled flag
findings.body: The cron finds unscheduled email reminders with method=EMAIL, scheduled=false, scheduledDate within 72h but with no filter on cancelled. Any reminder marked cancelled=true that is still unscheduled (or becomes cancelled between marking and scheduling) will be picked up and scheduled/sent via SendGrid. The fix relies on cancelled to suppress sends, so the schedule query must exclude cancelled=true, otherwise cancelled/rescheduled bookings still get emails.

findings.title: Async reminder cancellations fired in forEach without await
findings.body: handleCancelBooking.ts, bookings.tsx requestReschedule, and handleNewBooking.ts reschedule all call deleteScheduledEmailReminder / deleteScheduledSMSReminder (async DB update + network) inside Array.forEach without awaiting or Promise.all. The handler returns success before the prisma update cancelled=true completes, errors become unhandled rejections, and on process reuse or failure the cancellation can be lost so the 15-min cron never sees cancelled=true and the email is still sent.
